### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | No BJPS-specific AI policy page was found; the journal appears to fall under Oxford University Press's general (publisher-wide, not journal-specific) authors' AI-use policy. Per secondary summaries of that OUP policy: minor language/grammar-correction AI use does not require disclosure; any AI-generated content (text, data analysis, images) requires prior written permission from OUP plus a disclosure statement (tool/version, how used, validation steps); AI tools cannot be listed as an author. WebFetch could not directly confirm the policy text on the live OUP page (page returned only navigation/taxonomy, no policy prose), so this is sourced from WebSearch summaries citing that URL, not a verified direct read - treat as moderate-confidence, publisher-level (not BJPS-specific) inference. |
| **Source URL** | https://academic.oup.com/pages/for-authors/publishing-policies/author-use-of-artificial-intelligence |

### Preprint Policy

> AI-research note (not broken down per-stage): No blanket ban on preprints. Per BSPS author FAQ: if a paper has already been posted to a preprint archive (e.g. PhilSci-Archive), authors are instructed to change the title and paraphrase the abstract before submitting to BJPS to preserve anonymity in triple-masked review; if accepted, the original title may be restored subject to editorial approval. No explicit statement found on PhilSci-Archive/arXiv self-archiving rights post-publication (copyright terms only found: authors may reuse their own work elsewhere provided the Journal is acknowledged as original publisher and OUP is notified in writing/advance).
> Source: https://www.thebsps.org/faq/faq-authors/

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** General philosophy of science journal covering (per society About page) work spanning philosophy of physics, biology, cognitive science, formal/foundational topics, and history-adjacent themes (named recent thematic collections: T. S. Kuhn, philosophy of cognitive science). No 2024-2026 specific CFP or current-issue table of contents could be retrieved directly (journals.uchicago.edu and academic.oup.com issue pages both returned 403/404 to WebFetch); positioning is therefore inferred mainly from aims-and-scope language plus named thematic collections, not a fresh title-by-title scan.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** General/foundational philosophy of science, Philosophy of physics, Philosophy of biology, Philosophy of cognitive science, Formal/model-and-simulation-focused philosophy of science (per one secondary summary), Discussion notes responding to previously published BJPS articles

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.gate / leniency**: No BJPS- or even OUP-journals-division-specific AI policy page could be directly verified (live fetch of the cited OUP URL returned only site navigation, not policy prose). Figure is a secondary-source inference from WebSearch snippets about OUP's general (books + journals) AI policy, not a first-hand confirmed journal-specific rule.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev shows 'n/a' for immediate-rejection decision time/rate; no forum or aggregator gave a numeric desk-reject percentage.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No first-hand discussion found on SciRev comments, muchong.com, zhihu, or Reddit r/AskAcademia describing reviewer tone/culture for this specific journal. muchong and zhihu searches returned only journal-directory/listing pages or unrelated generic posts (one zhihu result even returned a mismatched ISSN/submission-URL for a different journal, discarded as noise), and the Reddit search returned zero journal-specific threads.
- **positioning.accepts_now (current TOC)**: Both journals.uchicago.edu and academic.oup.com current-issue/TOC pages returned 403/404 to WebFetch, so no direct 2025-2026 article-title sample was obtained; positioning relies on the About page's named thematic collections and general instructions instead of a fresh title scan.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- muchong.com (小木蟲): search surfaced only the general '论文投稿' board listing page, no BJPS-specific thread found - 0 first-hand results
- zhihu.com (知乎): search surfaced only generic 'how to submit to philosophy journals' articles and journal-directory list posts; one hit contained a mismatched/incorrect ISSN and submission URL for what appears to be a different journal and was discarded - 0 usable first-hand results
- reddit.com r/AskAcademia: search returned no journal-specific threads - 0 results
- letpub.com.cn (Chinese SCI-journal aggregator, cross-checked as closest Chinese first-hand-experience proxy beyond the mandated list): returned quantitative review-speed (>12 weeks) and a rating (7.1/10) but explicitly disclosed 0 shared author submission experiences underlying its qualitative 'easy acceptance' label
- SciRev: yielded quantitative first-round (~3.1 mo) and total (~4.7 mo) review times and avg. 2.5 review reports, though two separate extractions of the same page gave slightly inconsistent first-round figures (3.1 mo vs. ~4.1 mo/18 weeks)
